items.title: zplane launches PEEL STEMS 2 with improved real-time stem separation
items.excerpt: zplane released PEEL STEMS 2, a real-time AI stem-separation plugin that cuts latency from 483ms to 245ms at 44.1kHz while keeping all processing local. Priced at €59, it moves AI demixing from an offline chore into a live, in-session tool.

items.title: Eldoraudio Guitar Audio to MIDI Converter
items.excerpt: Eldoraudio's browser tool converts guitar recordings into editable MIDI using instrument-specific models, with the first 30 seconds free and a dedicated distorted-guitar model coming. It removes the manual transcription step between playing a riff and editing it as MIDI.

items.title: BandLab Technologies Acquires AI-Powered Digital Music Studio Aiode
items.excerpt: BandLab acquired Aiode, an AI music creation tool trained on licensed material that lets musicians upload half-finished tracks and complete them stem-by-stem using audio-to-audio models built with professional session musicians.

items.title: Record industry proposes AI labeling system for streaming platforms
items.excerpt: RIAA, IFPI and partners proposed an industry AI labeling standard with two tags — 'AI-generated' for fully AI-made tracks and 'AI-assisted' for tracks using some AI — surfaced on streaming platforms similarly to explicit-content markers.

items.title: New AI Labeling Standard for Music Draws Support — and Hesitation
items.excerpt: The industry's voluntary framework to label AI-generated and AI-assisted recordings draws support for transparency while sparking debate over how creators should implement standardized labels and metadata.

items.title: Why a fight over 61,000 recordings could shape the future of AI music licensing
items.excerpt: Suno challenged UMG and Sony's bid to add over 61,000 recordings to their copyright suit; the fair-use fight could set the precedent shaping how AI music tools can legally be trained and licensed.

items.title: Josh Fawaz Adds AI Credits to 'Like a Prayer' on Spotify After Widespread Backlash
items.excerpt: After an ABC investigation revealed heavy generative-AI use, Australian DJ Josh Fawaz added AI-vocal and AI-drum credits to his 38M-stream Madonna cover 'Like a Prayer,' spotlighting disclosure norms for AI-made hits.

items.title: Ocean Swift intros DevOcean Modular with MaYa, an AI agent that patches alongside you
items.excerpt: Ocean Swift's DevOcean Modular is a 145-module software synthesis and sound-design environment whose standout is MaYa, a modular AI agent that builds and patches modular setups collaboratively alongside the user rather than just auto-generating a result.
